entities.name: Bifunctional IspD/IspF
observations: 402 aa protein with N-terminal IspD domain (Pfam PF01128, residues 8-236) and C-terminal YgbB/IspF domain (Pfam PF02542, residues 242-394).
Homologs in reviewed Swiss-Prot proteins show approximately 58-60% identity over 97% of the sequence and carry the bifunctional IspD/IspF annotation.
Predicted role is in the methylerythritol phosphate pathway for isoprenoid biosynthesis.
Sequence-based assignment has moderate homology support; exact activity is inferred from highly similar reviewed homologs.
